activity_context.topic_title: Identifying the Pivot Columns of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The row echelon form matrix $B$ is given below. What are the pivot columns of $B?$

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $B$ has $2$ pivots in the $1$st and $3$rd columns:

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
